title: Closure under identifying input variables
statement: For every natural number $k$, the class of Boolean functions admitting a polynomial threshold representation of Fourier degree at most $k$ is closed under identifying input variables: for any natural numbers $n,m$, any map from the $n$ input coordinates to the $m$ input coordinates, and any function in the class on $n$ coordinates, the function obtained by substituting the coordinate indexed by the map for each original input coordinate belongs to the class on $m$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A map from the n input coordinates to the m input coordinates
A Boolean function in the polynomial threshold class on n coordinates
